---
description: 'Use when editing French, English, or Japanese JSON translations and localized SEO copy for Keola.'
applyTo: 'i18n/locales/*.json'
---

# Translation Files

- French (`fr-FR.json`) is the source locale reference.
  Add or remove each key in `en-US.json` and `ja-JP.json` in the same change; preserve placeholder names across all three.
- Keep SEO descriptions specific and short.
  Page titles use the full `Keola Kumaneko` brand.
  Social image-description keys in `app/data/seo.ts` must exist in all three locales; reuse existing descriptions when appropriate.
  Do not use `|` as punctuation: Vue I18n interprets it as plural syntax and cuts ordinary titles at that character.
- Keep the community name, contributor credits, links, and conservation messaging faithful to the confirmed facts in [.agents/docs/](../../.agents/docs/) and the current source; ask for any missing facts.
- Use the friendly, concise voice in [.agents/skills/keola-content/SKILL.md](../../.agents/skills/keola-content/SKILL.md).
  Localize alt text and functional labels, not just visible paragraphs.
- Don't set any text in raw, always use i18n json files.
